long_biography.plain_text:
Palico began life as MSG Holdings before Harpal Grewal became a director in 2002. He later emerged as its sole registered person with significant control, holding at least three-quarters of its shares and voting rights and the power to appoint or remove directors. The sequence establishes stewardship and ownership of an existing platform, not its founding.

Under Grewal, the Oxfordshire group has operated a large Domino's Pizza franchise network through regional companies. Those businesses include Hertford Heath, Capital Pizza, East London Pizza, Pizza Choice and DP Peterborough. He remains director of Palico and numerous operating or property companies, combining restaurant operations with supporting corporate and real-estate vehicles while keeping quick-service franchising at the centre of the business.

The dossier therefore uses vessel timing only for identity context and excludes all yacht claims from the biographies.

Companies House identifies Harpal as born in August 1979 and Moonpal as born in July 1969. Moonpal's Domino's shareholdings, MSG Holdco role and other appointments are not attributed to Harpal.

Palico was incorporated as MSG Holdings in 1993, when Harpal was a child, and he became a director in 2002 before later appearing as controlling shareholder. Public filings do not reveal whether the stake was purchased, inherited or transferred within a family or business arrangement.
